QuestInfo.name: [Heliseum] To Pantheon
QuestInfo.0: The operation to reclaim Heliseum is finally starting. Hear the details from #bBeldar#k in #bPantheon#k.
QuestInfo.1: The operation to reclaim Heliseum is finally starting. Hear the details from #bBeldar#k in #bPantheon#k.
QuestInfo.2: The operation to reclaim Heliseum is finally starting. Hear the details from #bBeldar#k in #bPantheon#k.

0.0: Are you doing well in Maple World, Angelic Buster? I'm sorry to interrupt your mission, but we need you in #bPantheon#k immediately. We're finally starting what we've longed for... #bOperation Free Heliseum#k.
0.1: We are finally going to reclaim Heliseum, the capital of the Nova, taken by Magnus. Of course, we're not entirely prepared, but we can't wait forever for the perfect moment. It's because the Outrigger, the holy relic protecting the Nova, is in Heliseum.
0.2: Hurry to Pantheon. I'll be waiting. \r\n#e#r* If you accept, you will be moved immediately.#k\r\n

1.0: You came, Angelic Buster. I knew you would.
